task_summary: Consolidate the 5-week NS1 binder-design project into a final shippable benchmark: report, repo, and ranked deliverable

steps.title: Reconstruct project timeline from artifacts
steps.description: Pull the key milestones from artifact history: pilot BindCraft run, multi-validator negative result, seed-5 discovery via 5-seed/6-seed analysis, positive-control harness validation, and the seed-5 refinement campaign (this session). Build a chronological milestone list with artifact references.

steps.title: Write final project report
steps.description: Synthesize into one top-level report (README.md): motivation/scope (NS1-only, beta-ladder direction), pipeline architecture, the harness-validation finding (AF2 broken for nanobodies, Boltz-2 validated), the seed-5 refinement campaign result (0/32 pass gate, ipTM/epitope-fidelity inversion replicated 4x), DENV1-4 conservation check, and honest assessment of what was and wasn't achieved against the original 5-week plan.

steps.title: Extract and package the validated scoring harness
steps.description: Pull out the Boltz-2 validation harness command (MSA server, recycling 3, no_kernels) and the epitope-fidelity contact-analysis code (heavy-atom, clash-floor corrected) used throughout this session into clean, documented, standalone scripts.

steps.title: Assemble repo structure with notebooks
steps.description: Organize scripts, the DENV1-4 alignment, key structures (seed5_HLT.pdb, cropped NS1 target), and a runnable analysis notebook demonstrating the harness on the final ranked table into a single repo-style archive.

steps.title: Assemble final benchmark bundle
steps.description: Package the final ranked binder table, master summary figure, DENV1-4 conservation figure, and methods write-up into one cohesive top-level deliverable set, cross-linked from the final report.

desired_outputs: Final project report (README-level) covering the full campaign arc
Reproducible scoring harness packaged as runnable scripts/notebook
Final ranked benchmark table + key figures bundle

feasibility.rationale: All underlying data (harness validation, seed-5 discovery, 32-design refinement campaign, DENV1-4 check) already exists and is verified; this phase is organization and synthesis, not new experiments. Main risk is scope creep across 168 artifacts spanning 5 weeks of work.
